description: This file is a Python source code implementing an IRC client library, including classes for IRC connections, event handling, and DCC (Direct Client-to-Client) connections, along with utility functions for IRC protocol message parsing and matching.

classes.name: IRC
classes.description: Manages multiple IRC server connections, handles event dispatching, and manages scheduled commands.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Base class for IRC connections, meant to be overridden.

classes.name: ServerConnection
classes.description: Represents a connection to an IRC server, manages socket communication, message parsing, and event handling.

classes.name: DCCConnection
classes.description: Represents a Direct Client-to-Client (DCC) connection, manages peer-to-peer socket communication.

classes.name: SimpleIRCClient
classes.description: A simple wrapper class for a single-server IRC client, with event handler methods.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents an IRC event with type, source, target, and arguments.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to an IRC server with specified parameters.

methods.name: add_global_handler
methods.description: Registers a global event handler for a specific event type.

methods.name: remove_global_handler
methods.description: Removes a registered global event handler.

methods.name: execute_at
methods.description: Schedules a function to be executed at a specific time.

methods.name: execute_delayed
methods.description: Schedules a function to be executed after a delay.

methods.name: process_once
methods.description: Processes incoming data once, with optional timeout.

methods.name: process_forever
methods.description: Runs an infinite loop processing incoming data.

methods.name: server
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ServerConnection object.

methods.name: dcc
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DCCConnection object.

methods.name: dcc
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DCCConnection object.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to an IRC server with specified parameters.

methods.name: dcc_listen
methods.description: Listens for incoming DCC peer connections.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the IRC client event loop.

methods.name: eventtype
methods.description: Returns the type of the IRC event.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Returns the source of the IRC event.

methods.name: target
methods.description: Returns the target of the IRC event.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments of the IRC event.
